resources.string: Not sent: a recipient’s device authorization has expired or changed. They may have signed out, switched devices, or not finished verification. Ask them to sign in and verify their device, then retry shortly. In a group, this may concern one member.
Sending was not authorized. Check your account and device verification status, then retry. Contact your administrator if access remains blocked.
The security service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again later; this does not establish whether the recipient is offline.
The send result could not be confirmed. Check your connection and the message status before retrying.
Recording stopped
Microphone access is off. Your recording has stopped and was not sent. Enable microphone access to record again.
Relay ended
Cancellation pending confirmation
Send result awaiting confirmation
Open with
The message was submitted and confirmation is pending. Check its status before sending again to avoid duplicates.
Search could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
Enter at least 3 characters. A full ID or exact account finds a specific person; nickname results are limited by directory visibility.
You have blocked this person. Unblock them in their profile before sending messages, calling, or sending a friend request.
You cannot contact this person right now. The message, call, or request was not sent.
This friend request has changed or ended. Return to the profile, check its current state, and send a new request if needed.
Your friend request is being processed. Please check it again shortly; do not send another request.
Contact permissions could not be checked. Nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.
Contact permissions have changed, but the displayed status has not synced yet. Reopen this profile shortly to check the result.

The identity reset result could not be confirmed. Your recovery record has been kept. Check your connection and return to this page to retry; the app will check the previous attempt before continuing. Your account has not been deleted.
Some forwarding results could not be confirmed. Check the destination chat before sending again to avoid duplicates. Confirmed forwards will not be repeated.
Forwarding did not complete. Check your connection and whether you can send to the selected chat, then try again. Confirmed forwards will not be repeated.
Chat verification expired. Please try again.
